regions.full_page: Buried Martin Kennedy - six. Altar boys pall - bearers- B. Landy, L. Schaefer, F. McCready and Alb. Ahearn. G. Gorman and C. O Hara. John Campbell and some other boys were to go with Fr. Sol. (who went with -) but the extra carriag had a mishap and the automobile that came in its place was late. Funeral was largely attended May He Rest In Peace!

regions.full_page: Epiphany Prizes and presents given to Altar boys. First prize 1 B. Landy (served 560 times) gold medal 2 G. Gorman 522 silver 3 Fr. Mc Cready 507 Pearl knife. Other prizes were given to A. Dempsey, C. O Hara, A. Ahearn, D. McCarthy, Jms Smith, Patrick Laughlin, J. Dempsey and others.

regions.full_page: Martin Kennedy's Mass. High Mass as 7th from funeral, for Martin Kennedy - requested by the Altar boys. The Mass was at 7 oclock and many went to Holy Communion, i. e. considering the very stormy and slushy morning- 13 Holy Communions. R.I. Pace!

regions.full_page: IN THE HOLY NAME OF JESUS LET US BEGIN THE YEAR 1912 The old year closed with a dreary day - rain, snow and fog - as though mourning at prospects it had to leave for the new year, of trouble and promises of war on all sides and directions.
